runtime.command: sh -c 'python -c "from app.migrations import upgrade_head; upgrade_head()" && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT}'

persistence.database: sqlite under STORAGE_PATH unless DATABASE_URL names Postgres
persistence.migrations: alembic upgrade head on boot (app.migrations.upgrade_head and scripts/entrypoint.sh); a failed migration refuses boot

rollback.schema: roll back the process to the prior image; the disk and its alembic version stay put

ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the whole suite (pytest tests) plus the audit and bench jobs
